info.description: Market regime monitoring for finance and fintech telemetry — returns, volatility, spreads, transaction volumes, settlement latencies. Classifies signal structure as stable / transition / unstable with a finance-calibrated engine (heavy tails, mean reversion), so risk and payment-ops teams see volatility regime shifts and structural breaks instead of threshold noise. Verdict badge, overlay, optional per-window deep timeline, audit replay for compliance, live quota footer. Detects structural change, not price direction — not investment advice.
